harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted volume (2GiB file-backed loop device at /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img, mapper name secure_srv) on node1, formatted it XFS, and mounted it at /srv/secure. Configured /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab with a root-fs-resident keyfile (/etc/luks-keys/secure.key, mode 400) so it unlocks and mounts automatically at boot with no manual intervention. Verified end-to-end with a full node reboot: boot_id changed (fbdf5b2c... -> 175dd2d7...), the cryptsetup and mount systemd units came up active on their own, and pre-restart test data written to /srv/secure survived.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disks/OS: RHEL 9.8, single 20G root disk, no spare block device available
Installed cryptsetup package via dnf
Created 2GiB backing file /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img and a random keyfile /etc/luks-keys/secure.key (mode 400)
Ran cryptsetup luksFormat on the backing file using the keyfile
Opened the LUKS volume as secure_srv, created an XFS filesystem, created /srv/secure mount point
Added crypttab entry (secure_srv, backing file path, keyfile, luks) and fstab entry (UUID of mapped fs, /srv/secure, xfs)
Verified mount -a mounts cleanly, fixed SELinux labeling with restorecon
Inspected generated systemd units (systemd-cryptsetup@secure_srv.service, srv-secure.mount) confirming correct RequiresMountsFor/ordering dependencies for boot-time auto-unlock
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, mount state, and wrote baseline.txt test data into /srv/secure
Issued systemctl reboot on node1; acknowledgement returned before the connection dropped
Polled node1 until exec access returned; confirmed new boot_id and uptime 0 (fresh boot)
Verified post-restart state: /srv/secure auto-mounted, cryptsetup and mount systemd units active, baseline.txt data intact

evidence.requirement: Encrypted (LUKS2) volume created, formatted, and mounted at /srv/secure
evidence.summary: Backing file created, cryptsetup luksFormat succeeded producing a LUKS UUID, mapped device formatted XFS

evidence.requirement: Volume unlocks and mounts automatically without manual steps (config in place)
evidence.summary: crypttab/fstab entries added, mount -a succeeded and SELinux relabeled, generated systemd-cryptsetup@secure_srv.service and srv-secure.mount units show correct dependency ordering for boot-time activation

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before restart (boot identity + service/data health)
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6), confirmed /srv/secure mounted, wrote baseline-data test file

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledged and executed one at a time via native safe mechanism
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background; command returned/disconnected before restart completed, confirming acknowledgement was returned pre-disconnect

evidence.requirement: Node became reachable again with proof of changed boot identity
evidence.summary: exec succeeded again showing new boot_id 175dd2d7-9999-4453-86de-3b5a9a28db98 (different from baseline) and uptime 0 minutes, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, mount, and data verified
evidence.summary: After reboot, /srv/secure is mounted via /dev/mapper/secure_srv, systemd-cryptsetup@secure_srv.service and srv-secure.mount are active, cryptsetup status shows the LUKS2 mapping active, and baseline.txt content 'baseline-data' was read back intact
